title: OHCHR report on detention in the context of Gaza hostilities
summary: OHCHR documented accounts and other information concerning Palestinian detention and the treatment of Israeli hostages between 7 October 2023 and 30 June 2024.
claim: OHCHR documented information that thousands of Palestinians had been taken into custody since 7 October 2023 and accounts of prolonged blindfolding, deprivation of food and sleep, beatings, electric shocks, and other ill-treatment; it also documented information concerning hostage-taking and reported ill-treatment of Israeli hostages by Palestinian armed groups.
legal_characterization: Documented evidence and accounts relevant to alleged arbitrary detention, torture or other ill-treatment, enforced disappearance, hostage-taking, and abuse; not an adjudication of individual cases.
source_organization: Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights
source_title: Detention in the context of the escalation of hostilities in Gaza (7 October 2023 - 30 June 2024)
source_quote: Thousands of Palestinians have been taken into custody, mostly men, but also women and children
verification_notes: Verified against the report's executive summary, scope, and methodology. The report covers 7 October 2023 to 30 June 2024 and explains access and verification limitations. DOCUMENTED_EVIDENCE is used for the bounded claim about information and accounts OHCHR documented; it does not convert each reported incident into an adjudicated factual or legal finding.
